title: Rogaliki (Polish Croissant Cookies)
hookLine: Polish-inspired rogaliki (polish croissant cookies) with 6 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Shape & Press Dough Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: In a medium bowl mix egg yolks, philly cheese and baking powder using a hand held mixer. Carefully start adding the flour. When the mixture will not be mixing well, and will look like wood chips, put away the blending mixer and using your hands knead the dough. Create a roll and cover in foil and freeze for 15 minutes. At this time preheat the oven to 375. Take the dough out and separate into two. Roll and cut out 3 inch trangles. Incorporate {m53024_1}, {m53024_2}, {m53024_3}, and {m53024_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure butter first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Shape & Press Dough Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: Make as many as you can and on centre of each put a small spoon of jam. Roll them into a croissant shape. Place the croissants onto a greased cookie sheet, and bake for 10-12 minutes or until golden. Repeat with the rest of the dough. Incorporate {m53024_5} and {m53024_6} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Bake Rogaliki (Polish Croissant Cookies) & Check Doneness
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake for 18 minutes until the edges turn golden and set while the center remains tender. Test with a toothpick—if it comes out with a few moist crumbs rather than wet batter, it is ready.

steps.title: Cool, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: When you take them out, put aside and sprinkle with powdered sugar on top. This makes about 3 batches of 20 cookies each. Total count about 60 cookies.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Let the tray rest 5 minutes on the counter after baking so edges crisp while centers stay bakery-soft.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 33 mins!
